annotations.title: Update, pause or resume a queue

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] `status: "paused"` stops new bookings (already-booked posts stay booked); "active" resumes. Other fields (platforms, cadenceHours, timeOfDay, lookahead, startsAt, name) apply from the next booking. Needs the `publish` scope (or admin) on the Agency plan or higher.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/queues/{id}.)

platforms.description: Replaces the queue's platforms for items booked from now on. Already-booked items keep theirs; items with their own `platforms` keep using them.

startsAt.description: ISO 8601 with an offset (or Z). Nothing is booked before it; the first slot is the first timeOfDay (in the queue's timezone) at or after it, so a startsAt that is itself a slot is the first slot. A past date holds nothing back. null clears it.
